form:FormGroup.label: Level
form:FormGroup.helpText: The severity of this rule. A detection from a rule with a high level should be prioritised over one from a rule with a low level. The level is included in the detections that this rule produces.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Low, Medium, High or Critical. Included in this rule's detections.

form:FormGroup.label: Status
form:FormGroup.helpText: How reliable this rule is, from Experimental through to Stable, or Deprecated for a rule that has been superseded. The status is included in the detections that this rule produces.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Experimental, Testing, Stable or Deprecated. Included in detections.

form:FormGroup.label: Include Rule Documentation
form:FormGroup.helpText: Include the rule's documentation in the detections it produces, including those sent by email. Untick to keep the documentation inside Stroom.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Adds the rule's documentation to its detections, including emails.

form:FormGroup.label: Feed For Errors
form:FormGroup.helpText: Feed that errors from running this rule are written to. If the rule has none, the default error feed is shown and used. A schedule cannot be enabled without an error feed. Administrators can select Set Default to make this feed the default for all rules.
